messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated crashlooping observed for runtime-engine pods (exit code 139) in cluster-us-west-2 (nodes: node-gpu-21,node-gpu-22). Count=15 restarts in 6m. Auto-notify: eng-sre + eng-runtime + eng-ml.

monitoring-bot: alert: pod_restart_count > 10 in 10m; sample pods: redwood-runtime-engine-rtfused-qd9lk (node-gpu-21). Recent logs attached.

Diane (eng-sre, oncall): Acknowledged. Eng-sre taking initial triage. Any deploys/rollouts in the last 30m? Customer impact?

bob (eng-runtime): There was a canary rollout 12m ago: image v4.0.0-rtfused (fused-attn enabled). I see segfaults inside a custom fused CUDA op. Container logs: "Fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 1, fault addr 0x0" followed by immediate restart.

bob (eng-runtime): logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T19:10:03Z] INFO model=redwood-13b request_id=xyz serve-start
[2026-03-15T19:10:04Z] ERROR runtime-engine: segfault at NULL in fused_attention.cu:427
[2026-03-15T19:10:04Z] ERROR core dumped -> /var/crash/runtime-engine.98765.core
```

Diane: good. Elaine, can you check node health and whether kernel/NVIDIA driver reported issues? Also please cordon node-gpu-21 to stop scheduling while we triage.

elaine (eng-infra): Cordon issued:
```
kubectl cordon node-gpu-21 --context=redwood-usw2
kubectl get nodes node-gpu-21 -o wide
```

elaine: dmesg shows repeated "NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus" and "kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, GPU has fallen off the bus". Driver: NVIDIA-SMI 540.73.11, kernel 6.4.0-88. Hardware team notified.

carlos (eng-ml): These crashes line up with big-context requests hitting the fused-kernel path. We enabled an optimized fused attention kernel that JITs some code at runtime. Hypothesis: JIT output + driver combo triggers an invalid memory access in some inputs.

bob: grabbed gdb bt from core on node-gpu-21:
```
#0  0x00007f8d2f1b2f1e in fused_attn_forward (ctx=0x7fff4) at fused_attention.cu:427
#1  0x00007f8d2f1b5a99 in launch_fused_kernel (args=0x7fff8) at fused_ops.cu:102
#2  0x000055c8a9d4f120 in runtime::invoke() at invoke.cc:210
#3  0x000055c8a9d4f3f6 in worker_thread() at worker.cc:88
```

bob: also see nvml errors in node logs: "Failed to query device info: Not Supported" right before the segfault in the same second.

Diane: For immediate mitigation: 1) scale the rtfused daemonset to 0 to stop the problematic daemon pods from flapping; 2) pin the runtime image for daemonset back to v3.2.5 (last known-good); 3) set runtime env to force non-fused codepath for deployments; 4) cordon/drain node-gpu-21. Who can run those?

bob: doing step 1+2 now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale ds/redwood-runtime-engine-rtfused --replicas=0
kubectl -n inference set image ds/redwood-runtime-engine-rtfused runtime-engine=registry.redwood/v3.2.5
```

deploy-bot: request acknowledged: scaling daemonset->0; image pin request queued.

bob: step 3 - patch configmap to disable fused path across deployments and rollout restart:
```
kubectl patch configmap runtime-flags -n inference -p '{"data":{"FORCE_NON_FUSED":"true"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-runtime-engine -n inference
```

bob: config applied; new pods report "using non-fused attention path" in startup logs. No segfaults observed in restarted pods so far (~2m).

alice (support): Customer impact: support dashboard shows a spike in 502s for hosted-api in us-west-2 between 19:08Z-19:12Z. ~12 customers affected, two higher-tier users reported timeouts for batch jobs. I've sent a short note with root-cause-in-progress to account teams.

Diane: good. Eng-sre will monitor platform metrics for 15m. Please preserve cores + full node logs. Elaine, collect nvidia-smi -q and pack driver logs into incident bucket.

elaine: uploaded artifacts to s3://incidents/3141599997/: cores, /var/log/messages, nvidia-smi.txt (driver 540.73.11), kernel logs, kubelet logs. Filed infra ticket INF-31415 to schedule hardware diagnostics for node-gpu-21.

carlos: immediate action items for eng-ml/eng-runtime: - reproduce in small harness with same driver (540.73.11) and kernel; - run fused-kernel under ASAN-like checks if possible; - add runtime guard to fall back per-request to safe path when device errors occur; - add canary gate that checks driver+kernel compatibility before enabling fused path.

bob: opening PR to pin daemonset and add env var CHECK_DRIVER_COMPAT in CI that blocks fused rollout for known-bad combos. Also adding per-request try/catch around fused kernel launch to fallback to non-fused.

Diane: triage severity set to P1 (partial regional degradation). Creating post-incident follow-up board item and assigning RCA owners: bob (runtime) + carlos (ml kernels) + elaine (infra). Oncall handover: I'll leave detailed notes in the incident runbook and hand to next oncall. Keep fused daemonset at 0 until we validate.

bob: will prepare an RCA timeline + stack traces and link to cores. Plan to revert the canary images and run expanded smoke tests.

monitoring-bot: incident checklist updated: daemonset scaled->0, node cordoned/drained, cores saved, artifacts uploaded.

Diane: closing the pager channel for active paging. We remain in follow-up mode; re-open if crashloops resume. Thanks for the fast response everyone. :heart:
